content.content: Please create a new 1-hour long event 'Follow-up meeting' on 2024-05-16 at 10:00 with the same participants as the 'Introductory meeting' event on 2024-05-15. The description should be 'Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.'.

```python
# Search for the 'Introductory meeting' event on 2024-05-15
introductory_meetings = search_calendar_events(query='Introductory meeting', date='2024-05-15')

# Check if we found the event
if not introductory_meetings:
    raise ValueError("Could not find the 'Introductory meeting' event on 2024-05-15.")

# Get the participants from the first matching event
introductory_meeting = introductory_meetings[0]
participants = introductory_meeting.participants

# Create the new 'Follow-up meeting' event
# Start time: 2024-05-16 10:00
# End time: 2024-05-16 11:00 (1 hour duration)
new_event = create_calendar_event(
    title='Follow-up meeting',
    start_time='2024-05-16 10:00',
    end_time='2024-05-16 11:00',
    description='Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.',
    participants=participants,
    location=None
)

# Print the result to confirm
print(f"Created event: {new_event.title} on {new_event.start_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")
```
